canonical_edits.oldQuote: [U_POP] Include units whose firstTelemetryTime is at or before global time0. Late telemetry units are outside this implementation cohort.
canonical_edits.replacement: [U_POP] Include every unit whose first accepted commissioning event is at or before global time0. First telemetry availability does not determine eligibility.

witnesses.quote: [U_POP] Include units whose firstTelemetryTime is at or before global time0. Late telemetry units are outside this implementation cohort.

canonical_edits.oldQuote: [U_ANCHOR] Anchor each included unit at its first accepted calibration event, not its commissioning event.
canonical_edits.replacement: [U_ANCHOR] Anchor each included unit at its first accepted commissioning event. Rejected commissioning attempts and later calibration do not move the origin.

witnesses.quote: [U_ANCHOR] Anchor each included unit at its first accepted calibration event, not its commissioning event.

canonical_edits.oldQuote: [U_METRIC] Report100 times fail outcomes divided by all included attempts, pooling attempts. Display the result as success percentage.
canonical_edits.replacement: [U_METRIC] Report100 times pass outcomes divided by all included attempts, pooling attempts. Display the result as success percentage.

witnesses.quote: [U_METRIC] Report100 times fail outcomes divided by all included attempts, pooling attempts. Display the result as success percentage.

interaction_meaning: Equal percentages with different cohorts, selected attempts, anchors and numerator polarity are coincidence, not semantic equivalence.
exact_scope: Authored typed role, identity, numeric and source-span invariants; independent semantics and live stage contributions remain required.
